verdict.rationale: GitLab docs confirm security/quality scanner findings (SAST, SCA, Secret Detection, DAST) surface directly in merge requests (gitlab-docs-2, gitlab-docs-3), which supports viewing third-party code quality reports in the review screen. However, there is no evidence addressing large-diff review performance or UX (e.g., diff pagination, collapsing, or performance on big changesets), and community comments note general performance issues with pushes/CI (gitlab-comm-1) that could bear on large-diff handling but don't directly confirm or deny it. Missing for 10: evidence of large-diff review UX/performance, independent corroboration of code quality report rendering in MR view.
